instruction: Candid studio photograph, full-shot at eye-level. In a bright dance studio with a large mirror, the woman in a black leotard and white tights (R1) stands on the right foreground with her back to the camera, holding the hands of the young girl in a pink tutu (R2). The girl (R2) stands en pointe facing the mirror, also with her back to the camera. The woman (R1) guides her raised arms. Their reflections are visible in the mirror on the left. Soft, bright daylight illuminates the studio.
